intro.text: An unnamed sailor taken on as an extra deckhand aboard the Wind's Pleasure.

items.text: In Tanat 1173, when the Wind's Pleasure put in at Amydlatn, Captain Tozbek hired him as an extra hand so the ship would not be short of crew on the voyage to New Natanan.
Yalb tried to win him over, telling him the crew would warm to him if he did his share of the dishwashing.
He joined the mutiny against Tozbek, taking part in the killing of several crewmen and in the attack on Jasnah Kholin. Shallan slipped away from him and the other thugs.

appearance.text: Six feet tall and hulking, with a blunt face, he was enormously strong. Yalb called him the "new kid" though he was at least five years older than Yalb.

personality.text: He said little, and Yalb took him for slow-witted.
